en: Job 22

p.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

en: Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,
u.src: 1  Then Eliphaz the Temanite answered,

p.src: 2  “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

ja: に益をもたらすだろうか。
en: “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.
u.src: 2  “Can a man be profitable to God? Surely he who is wise is profitable to himself.

p.src: 3  Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

ja: びになろうか。 あなたが自分の道を全うすることが、
en: Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?
u.src: 3  Is it any pleasure to the Almighty that you are righteous? Or does it benefit him that you make your ways perfect?

p.src: 4  Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

ja: きを争うのは、あなたの敬虔さのためだろうか。
en: Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?
u.src: 4  Is it for your piety that he reproves you, that he enters with you into judgment?

p.src: 5  Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

ja: きいではないか。 あなたの
には終わりがないではないか。
en: Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.
u.src: 5  Isn’t your wickedness great? Neither is there any end to your iniquities.

p.src: 6  For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

en: For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.
u.src: 6  For you have taken pledges from your brother for nothing, and stripped the naked of their clothing.

p.src: 7  You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

en: You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.
u.src: 7  You haven’t given water to the weary to drink, and you have withheld bread from the hungry.

p.src: 8  But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

ja: を所有し、 名望ある
en: But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.
u.src: 8  But as for the mighty man, he had the earth. The honorable man, he lived in it.

p.src: 9  You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

ja: で送り出し、 みなしごの
en: You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.
u.src: 9  You have sent widows away empty, and the arms of the fatherless have been broken.

p.src: 10  Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

ja: それゆえ、罠があなたの周りにあり、 突然の恐怖があなたを悩ませる。
en: Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,
u.src: 10  Therefore snares are around you. Sudden fear troubles you,

p.src: 11  or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

en: or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.
u.src: 11  or darkness, so that you can not see, and floods of waters cover you.

p.src: 12  “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

ja: い所におられないだろうか。
en: “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!
u.src: 12  “Isn’t God in the heights of heaven? See the height of the stars, how high they are!

p.src: 13  You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

ja: を知っているのか。 神は深い
って裁くことができるのか。
en: You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?
u.src: 13  You say, ‘What does God know? Can he judge through the thick darkness?

p.src: 14  Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

ja: ることがない。 神は
en: Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’
u.src: 14  Thick clouds are a covering to him, so that he doesn’t see. He walks on the vault of the sky.’

p.src: 15  Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

ja: あなたは昔の道を守るつもりか。 それは
en: Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,
u.src: 15  Will you keep the old way, which wicked men have trodden,

p.src: 16  who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

ja: ならぬうちに連れ去られ、 その土台は川のように
en: who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,
u.src: 16  who were snatched away before their time, whose foundation was poured out as a stream,

p.src: 17  who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

ja: をし得るというのか』と。
en: who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’
u.src: 17  who said to God, ‘Depart from us!’ and, ‘What can the Almighty do for us?’

p.src: 18  Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

en: Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.
u.src: 18  Yet he filled their houses with good things, but the counsel of the wicked is far from me.

p.src: 19  The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

en: The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,
u.src: 19  The righteous see it, and are glad. The innocent ridicule them,

p.src: 20  saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

ja: ち切られた。 火が彼らの
en: saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’
u.src: 20  saying, ‘Surely those who rose up against us are cut off. The fire has consumed their remnant.’

p.src: 21  “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

en: “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.
u.src: 21  “Acquaint yourself with him now, and be at peace. By it, good will come to you.

p.src: 22  Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

en: Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.
u.src: 22  Please receive instruction from his mouth, and lay up his words in your heart.

p.src: 23  If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

ja: される。 不義をあなたの天幕から遠ざけるなら。
en: If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.
u.src: 23  If you return to the Almighty, you will be built up, if you put away unrighteousness far from your tents.

p.src: 24  Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

en: Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.
u.src: 24  Lay your treasure in the dust, the gold of Ophir among the stones of the brooks.

p.src: 25  The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

ja: があなたの黄金となり、 あなたの尊い
en: The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.
u.src: 25  The Almighty will be your treasure, and precious silver to you.

p.src: 26  For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

en: For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.
u.src: 26  For then you will delight yourself in the Almighty, and will lift up your face to God.

p.src: 27  You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

en: You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.
u.src: 27  You will make your prayer to him, and he will hear you. You will pay your vows.

p.src: 28  You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

ja: めれば、それはあなたのために
en: You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.
u.src: 28  You will also decree a thing, and it will be established to you. Light will shine on your ways.

p.src: 29  When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

en: When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.
u.src: 29  When they cast down, you will say, ‘be lifted up.’ He will save the humble person.

p.src: 30  He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”

ja: のない者でなくても、神はその人を
す。 その人は、あなたの
en: He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
u.src: 30  He will even deliver him who is not innocent. Yes, he will be delivered through the cleanness of your hands.”
